name: Pro Yakyuu? Satsujin Jiken!
source:
Fictional baseball player is condemned as murderer. He has to hide from police and find the culprit to clear his name.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名虚构的职业棒球选手被认定为杀人犯。他必须躲避警方追捕并找出真凶，才能洗清自己的罪名。

[摘自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
